## Realm Calendar — `calendar_bp`

The realm keeps a calendar now. Every dawn is a new **Realm day**, and 96 of them make a **Realm Year** of four seasons: Thaw, High Sun, Harvest and Long Dark, 24 days each. In the middle of each season comes a four-day **festival** with its own activities: guard turtle hatchlings at night on the Hatchling Tide, race boats round an 8-checkpoint course at the Midsummer Regatta, carve pumpkins for the realm's vote at the Lantern Fair, and give gifts under falling stars on Starwright's Long Night. Activities pay **Festival Ribbons** to spend at the ribbon stall on titles, trails, hats and recipe cards, and the townsfolk have festival chapters for you. The rest of the year the **Gray Choir** comes for the towns now and then at night: three Ritual Circles rise around a town, and its people have twelve minutes to silence their bells.

### How to use

1. Run `/realm:calendar` to see the Realm day, the season, the next festival and whether a siege may come. A Realm day passes at each dawn (sleeping through the night counts too), so a day is about 13 to 20 minutes of play and a festival comes every 5 to 8 hours of play and lasts about an hour.
2. When a festival starts, everyone sees a title and a chat line. Open `/realm:calendar` and pick the festival for its three activities and what you've done of each. Each activity counts 3 times per festival (default 3, `activityMax`), not per day: sleeping through the festival doesn't reset it.
3. Every finished activity pays 2 Festival Ribbons (default 2, `activityRibbons`; the regatta 3, `regattaRibbons`) and 20 Crowns (default 20, `activityCrowns`), up to 15 ribbons (default 15, `ribbonCap`) and 250 Crowns (default 250, `crownCap`) per festival. Ribbons are paper with lore: they stack and you can trade them.
4. Spend ribbons at the **Festival Ribbon stall**: in `/realm:calendar` or at Quill the Trader (any townsfolk with the `merchant` role, `stallRole`) while a festival runs. It sells the festival's title, hat and recipe card, and two trails.
5. Talk to the townsfolk during a festival: four of them have a festival chapter each in [Story Questlines](#story-questlines--saga_bp), offered only while it runs (you can finish one after).
6. **Sieges:** when chat warns `The Gray Choir is coming to Riverside`, you have 3 minutes (default 3, `warnMinutes`). Then three Ritual Circles rise 48 to 96 blocks around the town (just outside it when the town is protected: with Town Projects' default 96-block safe zone, about 110 blocks out); their spots are in chat, the clock is in the top-left side box with an arrow to the town center (during the warning) or the nearest circle still singing (`Nearest circle NE 64m`), and the [Minimap](#minimap--map_bp)'s compass strip points there with its gold star. At each circle, beat its **Choir Singer** (a vindicator), then hit or tap its bell 5 times (default 5, `bellHits`). Silence all three within 12 minutes (default 12, `siegeMinutes`) and the town holds.
7. **Operators:** `/realm:calendar_siege` starts a siege now at the nearest town (or ends the one running), `/realm:calendar_set <day>` sets the day of the Realm Year (1-96), and `/realm:calendar` → **Operators** sets the regatta course and **Sieges** switches sieges off for a town. Settings are in `/realm:config` (**Realm Calendar**).

### What players see

- **The Realm Year:**

  | Season | Days | Festival | Festival days |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | Thaw | 1-24 | Hatchling Tide | 10-13 |
  | High Sun | 25-48 | Midsummer Regatta | 34-37 |
  | Harvest | 49-72 | Lantern Fair | 58-61 |
  | Long Dark | 73-96 | Starwright's Long Night | 82-85 |

  The townsfolk's birthdays ([Townsfolk](#townsfolk--npc_bp)) are days of this year. The day only goes forward: a `/time set` back to the morning is not a dawn, and setting the time from night to morning is.
- **The activities** (3 per festival):

  | Festival | Activity | What you do |
  |---|---|---|
  | Hatchling Tide | Nest Watch | At night, **Start a Nest Watch** in `/realm:calendar`: 3 baby turtles hatch beside you and zombies, husks and drowned come for them for 90 seconds (`nestSeconds`). Stay within 40 blocks; 2 must make it (`nestSaved`). The turtles head out to sea afterward (they're removed) |
  | Hatchling Tide | Turtle Feeding | Feed seagrass to turtles 5 times |
  | Hatchling Tide | Tide Swim | Swim 100 blocks without leaving the water |
  | Midsummer Regatta | The Regatta | In a boat, **Race the Regatta** in `/realm:calendar`: 8 checkpoints (`regatta.checkpoints`) on a loop 40 blocks out (`regatta.radius`), marked by sparkles, then back to the start, within 5 minutes (`regatta.seconds`). Within 6 blocks (`regatta.reach`) counts. The action bar shows the next checkpoint, the time and the distance. An operator's course (**Set the regatta course here**) is used within 32 blocks of its start; elsewhere the course starts where you are, looping to your right, each checkpoint moved onto water where it can be. The **Regatta board** keeps this year's best 10 times and the realm record |
  | Midsummer Regatta | High Dive | Jump from 20 blocks up or more and land in water |
  | Midsummer Regatta | Midsummer Picnic | Eat 3 different foods outdoors in the daytime |
  | Lantern Fair | Pumpkin Carve-off | Place a carved pumpkin or a jack o'lantern: your newest one is your entry (chat says where). Then vote for someone else's in **Carve-off vote** (one vote per festival). Entering and voting each count once |
  | Lantern Fair | Lantern Float | At night, stand at the water's edge holding a lantern and sneak: the lantern (one is used up) drifts up into the dark. Once a night |
  | Lantern Fair | Ghost Tales | At night, stay within 2 blocks of a lit campfire for 60 seconds: one of 8 ghost tales is told in chat |
  | Long Night | Starwatch | At night, stay under the open sky for 60 seconds: a shooting star comes for you ([Aurora & Shooting Stars](#aurora--shooting-stars--night_bp)) |
  | Long Night | Gift Round | Give gifts to 3 different townsfolk (sneak-tap holding a gift, [Townsfolk](#townsfolk--npc_bp)) |
  | Long Night | Candle Vigil | At night, place 4 candles |

- **Festival results:** when the Lantern Fair ends, the entry with the most votes wins the carve-off (the title `Pumpkin Champion`, chat and town gossip). Nobody can vote for their own pumpkin, so a carve-off with a single entry and no votes is won by it unopposed (`Ann's pumpkin was the only entry, so Ann wins the Pumpkin Carve-off unopposed!`). When the Midsummer Regatta ends, the best time wins the regatta (the title `Regatta Champion`).
- **Starwright's Long Night:** gifts to the townsfolk count double, every player under the open sky at night gets a shooting star once a night, and the Gray Choir keeps a truce (no sieges).
- **The ribbon stall** (cosmetics only):

  | Festival | Title (6 ribbons) | Hat | Recipe card (5 ribbons) |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | Hatchling Tide | `Hatchling Keeper` | Hatchling Cap (leather helmet, 4) | Sweet Berry Roll |
  | Midsummer Regatta | `Old Salt` | Sailor's Cap (leather helmet, 4) | Glow Berry Tart |
  | Lantern Fair | `Lantern Bearer` | Pumpkin Hat (carved pumpkin, 3) | Spiced Pumpkin Soup |
  | Long Night | `Keeper of the Long Night` | Star Crown (golden helmet, 5) | Hiccup Cookies |

  Any festival: the **Confetti** and **Festival notes** trails, 10 ribbons each ([Titles & Trails](#titles--trails--titles_bp)). Titles and trails need Titles & Trails, recipe cards need the [Kitchen](#kitchen--cooking_bp): without them those aren't sold. A recipe card is learned at once.
- **Sieges** come on a night when every one of these holds: `sieges` is Enabled; at least 2 non-AFK players are in the Overworld (default 2, `siegeMinPlayers`), or one who has finished Act II of the main story; 5 Realm days have passed since the last siege (default 5, `siegeGapDays`); it isn't the Long Night; and a target has a player within 192 blocks. Then there's a 35 percent chance (default 35, `siegeChance`; doubled during the Lantern Fair), once a night.
- **The target** is a town from [Town Projects](#town-projects--town_bp), the one with the most players near; every town can be besieged, protected or not (sieges never break blocks, and the circles rise just outside a protected town's safe zone); with `spareSafeTowns` Enabled (default Disabled), towns with **Protect from world events** are spared. Not one whose sieges an operator switched off in **Sieges**. With no such town: the lighthouse (a [Story Questlines](#story-questlines--saga_bp) place), else world spawn.
- **Where circles rise:** three ways around the town, 48 to 96 blocks out, or just past the edge of any safe zone there (10 blocks out, never more than 180 blocks from the town). Players only keep about 4 chunks around them loaded, so each spot is loaded first with a temporary ticking area (`realm_siege_0` to `realm_siege_2`, 2 chunks around it; up to 15 s), then up to 24 spots within 22 blocks of it are tried. A ticking area stays while its circle stands and goes once the siege ends and the ground is put back (or at once when no circle fits there). Where that ground is too built up or wooded, around the players near the town (12 to 48 blocks from them, within 180 of the town). If no circle fits anywhere, chat says `The Choir found no open ground around Lanternford for its circles and scattered. Nothing was lost.`: no mood, and it doesn't count as the last siege.
- **Ritual Circles:** a 3 by 3 gray concrete floor with a bell in the middle and 4 lit white candles, on open, flat, natural ground (never on anything built, never in a tree, never under a roof), not in a safe zone or a land claim. The ground is saved first and put back afterward (blocks someone placed inside the circle since stay). The circles' blocks can't be broken or blown up during the siege.
- **The Choir:** at each circle a **Choir Singer** (a named vindicator) and 4 to 6 **Choir Chanters** (pillagers, `pillagersMin`, `pillagersMax`); no banners, so no captain, no Bad Omen and no raid. Each 3 Choir Cairns silenced in [Atlas of the Realm](#atlas-of-the-realm--atlas_bp), realm-wide, take one Chanter away (up to 6). Halfway through, 2 more Chanters come to every circle still singing. A bell counts only once its Singer is down; a silenced circle's Choir leaves. At most 24 Choir mobs at once. Pillagers despawn the moment nobody is within about 54 blocks (a name doesn't keep them), so a circle's Chanters gather as players come: those not yet beaten come back when someone comes within 40 blocks. The Singer stays.
- **Taking part:** hit a Choir mob, hit or tap a circle's bell, or spend 3 minutes within 96 blocks of the town or a circle.
- **Held:** every participant gets 60 Crowns (`heldCrowns`), 20 Wardens reputation (`heldRep`) and 80 Combat XP (`heldXp`, [Skills](#skills--skills_bp)); the town is **Heartened** for 24 hours (`moodHours`): [Town Projects](#town-projects--town_bp) counts its deliveries x1.25.
- **Failed** (the 12 minutes run out): 15 Crowns each (`failedCrowns`); the town is **Shaken** for 24 hours (the town menu says so, the townsfolk talk about it and Brother Hollis heard the singing).
- **Nothing breaks a block:** the circles are put back, the Choir is removed when the siege ends, and Choir mobs left in unloaded chunks are removed as soon as they load. A restart during a siege ends it with no result (the circles are put back, no mood).

### Commands

| Command | Who | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `/realm:calendar` | Everyone | The Realm day, season and next festival; during a festival its activities (Nest Watch, the regatta and its board, the carve-off vote) and the Festival Ribbon stall; the Realm Year; siege history and the towns' moods; for operators the regatta course, a siege and each town's siege switch |
| `/realm:calendar_siege` | Operators | Starts a Choir siege now at the nearest town (any time, any player count; after a confirmation), or ends the siege running (no rewards, no mood) |
| `/realm:calendar_set <day>` | Operators | Sets the day of the Realm Year, 1 to 96 (`/realm:calendar_set 34` starts the Midsummer Regatta). Festivals start and end at once; activity limits stay per festival and year |

### Configuration (`scripts/config.js` → `CONFIG`)

| Option | Default | Description |

| `festivals` | `true` | Festivals, their activities, ribbons and the stall. Disabled, the calendar still counts days and `realm:calendar` names no festival |
| `announce` | `true` | A title and a chat line when a festival starts and ends |
| `activityMax` | `3` | Times each activity counts per festival, per player |
| `ribbonCap` | `15` | Festival Ribbons a player can earn per festival |
| `crownCap` | `250` | Crowns a player can earn per festival from the activities |
| `activityRibbons`, `activityCrowns` | `2`, `20` | Ribbons and Crowns for one activity |
| `regattaRibbons` | `3` | Ribbons for a finished regatta |
| `stallRole` | `"merchant"` | Townsfolk with this role run the ribbon stall during a festival |
| `regatta.checkpoints`, `regatta.radius`, `regatta.reach`, `regatta.seconds` | `8`, `40`, `6`, `300` | The regatta's checkpoints, how far out the loop goes, how close counts, and the time limit in seconds |
| `nestSeconds`, `nestHatchlings`, `nestSaved` | `90`, `3`, `2` | How long a Nest Watch lasts, how many hatchlings, and how many must make it |
| `sieges` | `true` | Choir sieges at night |
| `siegeChance` | `35` | Percent chance on a night that qualifies (doubled during the Lantern Fair) |
| `siegeMinPlayers` | `2` | Non-AFK Overworld players for a siege (or one who has finished Act II) |
| `siegeGapDays` | `5` | Realm days between sieges |
| `warnMinutes` | `3` | Minutes of warning before the circles rise |
| `siegeMinutes` | `12` | Minutes to silence the circles |
| `spareSafeTowns` | `false` | Enabled, towns with **Protect from world events** are never besieged |
| `bellHits` | `5` | Hits a bell needs once its Singer is down |
| `pillagersMin`, `pillagersMax` | `4`, `6` | Choir Chanters at each circle |
| `heldCrowns`, `heldRep`, `heldXp` | `60`, `20`, `80` | Each participant's reward when the town holds (Crowns, Wardens reputation, Combat XP) |
| `failedCrowns` | `15` | Each participant's Crowns when the siege fails |
| `moodHours` | `24` | Hours a town stays Heartened or Shaken (real time) |

Operators can change `festivals`, `announce`, `activityMax`, `ribbonCap`, `crownCap`, `sieges`, `siegeChance`, `siegeMinPlayers`, `siegeGapDays`, `warnMinutes`, `siegeMinutes`, `spareSafeTowns`, `bellHits`, `heldCrowns`, `failedCrowns` and `moodHours` in game with `/realm:config` (**Realm Calendar**). The festivals' activities, the stall's stock and the ghost tales are in `scripts/lore.js`.

### Saved data

| Key | Scope | Contents |
|---|---|---|
| `cal:day` | World | JSON `{ d, n }`: the Realm day, and `n: 1` once tonight's night was seen (the next dawn counts) |
| `cal:meta` | World | JSON `{ fk, last, tried, cairns, course? }`: the festival running (`<year>:<festival>`), the day of the last siege and of the last night a siege was rolled, up to 18 Atlas cairns silenced, the regatta course `{ x, y, z, h }` |
| `cal:siege` | World | JSON: the siege running (target, times, circles with their bell hits, participants), cleared when it ends |
| `cal:hist` | World | JSON `[[day, town, result], ...]`: the last 12 sieges |
| `cal:moods` | World | JSON `{ <town id>: [name, mood, until] }`: Heartened or Shaken towns, until when (ms) |
| `cal:towns` | World | JSON `{ <town id>: 0 }`: towns whose sieges an operator switched off |
| `cal:fair` | World | JSON `{ k, e, v }`: this Lantern Fair's carve-off entries `{ <player id>: [name, x, y, z] }` (up to 60) and votes |
| `cal:board` | World | JSON `{ k, top, best }`: this year's regatta board (10 best times) and the realm record |
| `cal:restore` | World | JSON `[[structure, dim, x, y, z], ...]`: circles whose ground is still to be put back (a restart, an unloaded spot) |
| Structures `cal:circle_<siege>_<n>` | World | The ground under each circle from before it rose (3 by 3 by 3), deleted once put back |
| `cal:p` | Player | JSON `{ k, a, r, c, v?, f?, e?, g?, cd?, ln?, sn? }`: this festival's activity counts, ribbons and Crowns earned, the carve-off vote, progress toward the next feeding, picnic, Gift Round and vigil, the day of the last lantern and shooting star. Under 1 KB |
| `cal:cfg` | World | Settings changed in `/realm:config` |

### How it works

- **The day counter** was in [Townsfolk](#townsfolk--npc_bp) before this pack. The first time this pack runs it asks Townsfolk for its day (`realm:calendar_ping` `{ own: true }`, which Townsfolk answers even while it only listens), takes it, and from then on counts the dawns itself (twice a second: the time of day 12000 or later is "night seen", then under 6000 is a dawn). It sends `realm:calendar` `{ day, doy, year, season, festival?, ends?, from: "calendar_bp" }` at every dawn, 2 seconds after the world loads, when a player joins, on `realm:calendar_ping` and every 5 minutes, so Townsfolk stays quiet (it waits 2 hours after the last message) and uses this day for its birthdays. Without Townsfolk the first day is day 1.
- **Activities** watch what players do: every half second each Overworld player during a festival (swimming, a fall into water, sneaking at the water with a lantern, a campfire nearby every 2 seconds, the open sky), and the block placed (pumpkins, candles), the entity tapped with seagrass, the food eaten and Townsfolk's `realm:npc_gift` `{ player, npc, tier }`. Each counted one sends `realm:quest_done` `{ player, pack: "calendar_bp", id: "cal:<activity>", label, kind: "festival", guild }`, which [Guilds](#guilds--reputation--guilds_bp) turns into reputation and the festival chapters count.
- **Sieges** look every 10 seconds at night. The towns come from Town Projects' `realm:town_list` (every town and whether it's safe), the lighthouse from Story Questlines' `realm:place_ready`, Act II from `realm:saga_progress`, the AFK state from the `afk` tag, claims from `realm:claims_check` and safe zones from the [safe zones protocol](#how-the-packs-work-together). Each side's spot is loaded with a ticking area first (it counts toward Bedrock's 10 per world while it's there; if all 10 are taken, only ground players keep loaded can be used), then tried up to 24 times; a siege whose circles all fail scatters (no result, and another can come the next night). The ground is saved with `structureManager.createFromWorld` before the first block changes.
- **Messages sent:** `realm:siege` `{ state: "warn" | "on" | "end", town, id, result? }` (`held`, `failed`, `scattered`), `realm:sky_event` `{ kind: "siege", dim, x, z, text }` at the warning (the inn's news), `realm:town_state` `{ town, name, mood, until }` for each Heartened or Shaken town (also after a load and on `realm:town_state_ping`), and for each participant `realm:quest_done` (kind `siege`, Wardens), `realm:rep_add`, `realm:skill_xp` and `realm:gossip` (kinds `siege` and `siege_lost`; `regatta` and `carve_off` for the festival winners). The stall sends `realm:title_unlock`, `realm:trail_unlock` and `realm:recipe_learn`; the Long Night `realm:sky_request` `{ kind: "shooting_star" }`.
- **Testing hook:** `/scriptevent realm:calendar_debug {"action":"state","player":"<id>"}` answers with `realm:calendar_state`; other actions: `setday` (`doy`), `forget` (the handoff from Townsfolk again), `siege` (`town`, `warn` seconds, `pillagers`), `roll` (`force`, `chance`, `reset`), `singers`, `bell` (`circle`), `expire`, `end` (`result`), `cairn` (`key`), `complete` (`activity`), `nest`, `race`, `cp`, `feed`, `eat` (`food`), `gift` (`npc`), `vote` (`for`). Only from the console, scripts and operators. Scenario: `tools/test-bds/examples/calendar.js`.

---

## Guilds & Reputation — `guilds_bp`

Four guilds you rise through by playing: the Miners, the Growers, the Wardens (combat) and the Wayfarers (exploration and the sea). Finished quests and bounties earn reputation with the guild they suit, and so do plain mining, farming, fighting and traveling, a little at a time. Each guild has five ranks from Initiate to Master; higher ranks unlock more of the guild's shop (paid in Crowns), a small perk at Journeyman, and the titles `Expert Miner` and `Master Miner` (and so on) for the [Titles & Trails](#titles--trails--titles_bp) pack.

### How to use

1. Play: mining ores, harvesting grown crops, defeating monsters and traveling slowly earn reputation with the Miners, Growers, Wardens and Wayfarers. Finished [Daily Quests](#daily-quests--quests_bp), [Story Questlines](#story-questlines--saga_bp) chapters and [Bounty Board](#bounty-board--bounty_bp) bounties earn more, with a chat line such as `+10 Miners rep (Mine 12 coal ore)`.
2. Rank up: chat says `Miners' Guild: you are now a Journeyman! (300 rep)`, with any new perk and new shop stock. Reaching Expert or Master is announced to everyone and unlocks a title.
3. Run `/realm:guilds` to see your rank in all four guilds, a bar to the next rank (`Journeyman at 300 (120 to go)`), each guild's perk and your Crowns. Its buttons open each guild's shop.
4. In a shop, tap an item to buy it with Crowns. Gray items need a higher rank, shown under them (`[Expert]`).
5. Talk to a guildmaster (the [Townsfolk](#townsfolk--npc_bp) pack's Warden Reyes) and pick **Guild hall** for the same menu.
6. Don't want the reputation lines in chat? Disable **Reputation notes in chat** in `/realm:prefs`.
7. **Operators:** `/realm:config` → **Guilds & Reputation** sets whether plain play earns reputation and how much, whether the perks are on, and the rank they need. Ranks, shops, titles and quest rewards are in `config.js`.

### What players see

- **Ranks** (`ranks`): Initiate (0 rep), Member (100), Journeyman (300), Expert (700), Master (1,500), separately in each guild.
- **Reputation from quests** (`realm:quest_done` from any pack): 10 for a daily quest (`questRep`), 30 for a story chapter, 25 for a bounty, 20 for a treasure map or tournament, 15 for a town project, 30 for a finished expedition. Kinds go to guilds as in `kindGuild`: mining and placing blocks to the Miners, harvesting and eating to the Growers, defeating mobs, bounties and expeditions to the Wardens, traveling, fishing and treasure to the Wayfarers. A quest that names a guild goes to that guild; anything else (a story chapter or town project without one) is shared evenly between all four.
- **Reputation from other packs** (`realm:rep_add`) can add or take away reputation, for example a story choice. Reputation never drops below 0.
- **Reputation from plain play** (`passive`), quietly: 1 Miners rep per 10 ores mined (`ores`; ores you placed lately don't count), 1 Growers rep per 25 grown crops harvested, broken or tapped (`crops`), 1 Wardens rep per 10 hostile mobs defeated (`hostile`), 5 Wardens rep for defeating or helping to defeat a [champion](#champions--elite_bp), and 1 Wayfarers rep per 500 blocks traveled any way (teleports don't count, and neither does moving while the [AFK](#afk--smart-sleep--afk_bp) pack marks you away, such as riding a minecart loop). Creative and spectator mode earn nothing here.
- **Perks** (`perks`), from Journeyman (`perkRank`) in that guild:

  | Guild | Perk |
  |---|---|
  | Miners | Mining 20 ores within 60 seconds gives Haste I for 30 seconds |
  | Growers | A 25% chance of one extra crop when you harvest a grown crop |
  | Wardens | Strength I for 10 seconds after you defeat, or help to defeat, a champion |
  | Wayfarers | Sprinting 200 blocks gives Speed I for 20 seconds |

  A perk that starts says so above the hotbar (`Miners' Guild: Haste I for 30s`).
- **Titles:** reaching Expert and Master (`titleRanks`) unlocks `Expert Miner`, `Expert Grower`, `Expert Warden` and `Expert Wayfarer`, and at Master `Miners' Guildmaster`, `Growers' Guildmaster`, `Wardens' Guildmaster` and `Wayfarers' Guildmaster` (`topTitle`), so the top title never reads like [Skills](#skills--skills_bp)' `Master Miner`. Players pick them in the Titles pack. Each title your ranks unlock is sent again 11 seconds after you join, so a Master from before this change gets the Guildmaster title too (and keeps the old `Master Miner`).
- **Perk effects never stack:** a perk's Haste, Strength or Speed I is skipped while you already have a stronger or longer one (a [Skills](#skills--skills_bp) Calling's Haste II, a potion): the higher one wins.
- **Reputation earned while offline** (a bounty paid out after you left) is added when you next join: `+25 Wardens rep (while you were away)`.
- **The shops** (`shops`), one item per rank in each guild by default:

  | Rank | Miners | Growers | Wardens | Wayfarers |
  |---|---|---|---|---|
  | Initiate | 32 torches, 8 | 16 bone meal, 6 | 32 arrows, 10 | 8 bread, 6 |
  | Member | Iron pickaxe, 40 | 8 golden carrots, 30 | Iron sword, 30 | Empty map, 20 |
  | Journeyman | 4 TNT, 60 | 4 cherry saplings, 40 | Shield, 40 | 4 ender pearls, 60 |
  | Expert | Diamond pickaxe, 200 | 2 golden apples, 120 | Totem of Undying, 300 | Saddle, 80 |
  | Master | Netherite scrap, 400 | Sniffer egg, 400 | Trident, 500 | Heart of the Sea, 300 |

  Prices are in [Crowns](#crowns--crowns_bp). Buying says `-40 Crowns (Miners' Guild: 1 Iron Pickaxe)` in chat; what doesn't fit in your inventory drops at your feet.

### Commands

| Command | Who | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `/realm:guilds` | Everyone | Your rank, reputation and progress to the next rank in all four guilds, their perks (from Journeyman, `perkRank`), and buttons for each guild's shop |

| Option | Default | Description |

| `guilds.growers.name`, `guilds.growers.member` | `"Growers' Guild"`, `"Grower"` | The same for the Growers |

| `questRep.bounty` | `25` | For a bounty |

| `questRep.other` | `10` | For any other kind |
| `kindGuild.mine`, `kindGuild.place` | `"miners"` | The guild those quest kinds count for |
